uncreated_tensor_check.interpretation: No uncreated/unused tensor dump appeared under LLAMA_DUMP_UNCREATED_TENSORS=1, so remaining correctness failure is not explained by an obvious unconsumed tensor after current aliases.

source_audit_summary.alias_layer: Existing default-off aliases cover hc/output_hc, .weight suffixes, attn_kv_latent->attn_kv, compressor names, exp_probs_b.bias, and tid2eid .weight.
source_audit_summary.moe_route: DeepSeek4 build_moe_v4 uses ffn_gate_tid2eid if present; 4Expert has only 3 tid2eid_weight tensors, not all 43 layers, so later layers fall back to exp_probs_b bias/topk route.
source_audit_summary.tokenizer: 4Expert tokenizer is bpe with joyai-llm pre and token_type zeros; native is gpt2. The token_type workaround fixes empty pieces but not semantic correctness.
source_audit_summary.known_good_reference: There is no known-good vendor/HF runtime output for this exact 4Expert GGUF in the current workspace, so layer/logit parity cannot be judged against a trusted implementation. Native model is structurally different (expert_used_count 6 vs 4 and tensor quantization/layout differences), so native logits are not a valid exact parity oracle.

root_cause_assessment.most_likely: model/interface or numerical compatibility mismatch after loading, not a simple missing tensor or chat-template issue
root_cause_assessment.why_not_missing_tensor: LLAMA_DUMP_UNCREATED_TENSORS follow-up showed no obvious uncreated/unused tensor lines after current aliases.
root_cause_assessment.why_not_template_only: default, deepseek, and deepseek3 templates all failed with different but clearly invalid outputs.
root_cause_assessment.why_not_tokenizer_only: token_type fix made pieces visible and native default-off regression remained correct, but 4Expert generated degenerate text.
root_cause_assessment.why_not_native_parity: native and 4Expert are not the same computation: tokenizer/pre/context/expert_used_count/types differ; exact native logits/top1 mismatch would not isolate a bug.

probe_options.not_recommended_more_template_smokes: Already exhausted low-cost template checks; repeated prompt runs do not isolate root cause and consume strict-cold time.
probe_options.possible_small_header_only: A richer GGUF metadata/tensor naming audit can be done, but existing header evidence already shows no obvious missing tensors and many structural differences.
probe_options.possible_default_off_source_probe: A diagnostic-only route dump could record per-layer selected expert ids/tid2eid use/exp_probs path under France n1, but without a known-good reference it would only confirm behavior, not correctness. It may be useful only if the next question is whether ffn_gate_tid2eid should apply beyond the first 3 hash layers.
probe_options.possible_reference_needed: A meaningful numerical parity plan would need a trusted implementation or official expected outputs for this exact GGUF; otherwise the probe cannot distinguish bad quantized artifact from loader bug.

decision.recommended_next: Keep 4Expert closed for performance. If reopened, first write a narrow default-off route-dump plan focused on tid2eid/hash-layer semantics, or obtain a known-good reference output/runtime for this exact 4Expert artifact. Do not benchmark token rate before France correctness passes.
decision.cleanup_relevance: 4Expert is a protected local candidate only if future correctness work continues; rejected IQ2_S remains the larger immediate disk cleanup question.
